definitions.gloss: to appear; to show oneself; to come into view
definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something becoming visible, often after being absent, hidden, or anticipated. Used for both physical appearances and figurative emergence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}した。
examples.english: The moon appeared from between the clouds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}して⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The culprit has not yet shown himself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{高層|こうそう}ビル→高層ビル：16994_kousoubiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{姿|すがた}を{現|あらわ}し、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: A new high-rise building appeared in front of the station, and the scenery of the town completely changed.

notes:
USAGE:
A set phrase combining ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (figure, form) with ⟦{現|あらわ}す→現す：02097_arawasu⟧ (to reveal). Often used in narrative and news contexts to describe someone or something coming into view. The subject can be a person, animal, building, or natural phenomenon.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to disappear — the opposite expression, meaning to vanish from sight
- ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: to appear — a simpler, single-verb alternative without the nuance of revealing a full figure
